why_no_new_terms: An outline places; it defines almost nothing it does not also name as known. Its §1 is the cast the wiki already has pages for (the thirteen Alters, AEGIS, Juna, Mnemosyne), plus the Erasure-Pol, whose name it marks open (L161, J59). Its §2 names the four worlds by the bearers' names (J49). What remains is its own structure (Kishōtenketsu, the four levels, the three modes, Bridge, Soft-Layering, chapter and beat titles — J31, J9), Dramatica slot vocabulary (Storyform A/B, Cost/Dividend, Signposts), craft labels (Tonale Achse, Genesis-Echo, POV fields), and names used as known and nowhere explained (Controlled Fragmentation Protocol, Stress-Test Delta-7, Lyons-Welt, Babymonster-Welt, Gödel-Gambit). Komponente 734 is Kael's designation and stays a reading on kael, as for the three canon-era documents before it.
not_promoted_rule: 320 new terms by lookup, none became a page. By the rule above: the document's structure and slot vocabulary, borrowed theory in its home sense (Kishōtenketsu, Murdock/Schmidt, Campbell/Vogler, the DKT correlates, which go on the Alter pages as readings), names the document marks open (Erasure-Pol, Wir-AEGIS-plural — OQ-A), and names it uses without saying what they are. The Vortex architecture (Vortex 1 operativ, Vortex 2 ontologisch, L31) is the nearest to a definition and is left for a source that defines it rather than schedules it.
